ORDER % 08.07.2025 CM Appl.39538/2025[Exemption from filing certified copies]
1. Allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The Application stands disposed of.

CM Appl.39537/2025[Exemption from impleading driver and owner]
3. This is an Application filed on behalf of the Appellant seeking exemption from impleading the driver and owner as parties in the present Appeal.
4. Learned Counsel for Respondent No.1 submits that he has no objection if the prayers made in the present Application are allowed.
5. The Application is accordingly allowed.

6. The present Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 impugning the award dated 04.04.2025 passed by the learned Presiding Officer, MACT-01, Tis Hazari Courts,
Delhi [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"].

sentences.text:
8. Learned Counsel for the Appellant submits that the injury of the Appellant was assessed at 90%
temporary locomotor disability in his left lower limb and given the fact that he is working as a tailor,
his functional disability would be 100%. However, this aspect was not adequately examined by the learned Tribunal.
Secondly, it is contended that no amount has been given for future medical expenses and the non-pecuniary award is also less than as set out in terms of the settled law.
9. Issue Notice.
Learned Counsel for Respondent accepts Notice.
10. Replies to the pending Applications be filed within a period of six weeks.
10.1 Rejoinder(s), if any, be filed within a period of four weeks thereafter.
11. The Registry is directed to place on record the digital copy of the Trial Court Record duly paginated and book-marked in accordance with the rules of the High Court.

12. The parties shall file their respective written synopsis, not exceeding three pages each, at least three days before the next date of hearing, along with the compilation of judgments, if any, they wish to rely upon.
12.1 All judgments sought to be relied upon shall be filed with an index which also sets out the relevant paragraph numbers and the proposition of law that it sets forth.
13. List for hearing on 12.12.2025.
TARA VITASTA GANJU, J JULY 8, 2025/r
